$comment: Roll XI content target. This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what the finished dataset should contain. It declares scope as rules. scripts/coverage.mjs derives progress from the canonical decade shards and can prove depth/completeness only for editions where expectedRostersPerEdition is populated. Do not hand-edit progress into this file: progress is derived. Only edit this file to change the goal or to add researched expected counts.

stageCodes.MAIN: Main draw participant, round unknown or not applicable

roles.roster: Club-season has a full player list. Draftable in Campaign and available to Daily and Chains.
roles.stub: Club-season has no player list and is not draftable. It may carry rating/kit/scorer summary data and European coverage facts. It is Campaign opposition only when achievements[] contains W/RU/SF; GROUP/QF/MAIN stubs are coverage-only placeholders until upgraded to full rosters.
roles.$note: Depth and opponent eligibility are independent. A roster or stub can be Campaign opposition when achievements[] contains W/RU/SF. The legacy tierType field was removed on 2026-08-07; role + achievements[] are now the only runtime schema.

scopes.label: Serie A, full history
scopes.excludeReason: Decided 2026-08-07: wartime and immediate post-war seasons are OUT OF SCOPE. Campionato Alta Italia 1944 and Divisione Nazionale 1945-46 were not a single national round-robin Serie A and are excluded permanently, not pending review.
scopes.rule: Every club that competed in the top division that season gets a full roster.
scopes.$expectedRostersNote: 1997-98, 1998-99 and 1999-00 each have a researched 18-club Serie A field. Other Serie A seasons remain unproven until their expected counts are populated.

scopes.$note: Decided 2026-08-07: pre-1995 International Football Cup is OUT OF SCOPE permanently. Scope begins at the UEFA-run era, 1995. Format note: no separate qualifying tier to exclude 1995-2005 (see top-level mainDrawDefinition.perCompetitionNotes.ITC); 2006-2008 used 11 parallel mini-tournaments with no runner-up designation.

mainDrawDefinition.rule: Main draw = the first competition stage after qualifying/preliminary rounds. Where the competition has a group or league phase, that phase is the main draw; where the competition is straight knockout, Round 1 proper is the main draw. Qualifying and preliminary rounds are out of scope.

perCompetitionNotes.EC: 1955-56 to 1991-92 had no group stage; it was a straight knockout. For these editions 'main draw' means Round 1 proper. A small number of early editions ran a preliminary round for lower-ranked federations before Round 1 — that preliminary round is excluded. Needs per-edition verification; do not assume Round 1 fields are uniform in size.
perCompetitionNotes.UCL: 1992-93 to 2023-24: group stage participants, i.e. teams that survived qualifying and were drawn into the eight (later four) groups. 2024-25 onward: league-phase participants (36 teams), which plays the same structural role as the old group stage. Qualifying-round-only exits are excluded even if the club is well known.
perCompetitionNotes.CWC: Straight knockout throughout its history (1960-61 to 1998-99), same treatment as pre-1992 EC: 'main draw' means Round 1 proper, excluding any preliminary round used for smaller federations in some seasons.
perCompetitionNotes.FAIRS: Straight knockout, city-based entry in its earliest editions. 'Main draw' means Round 1 proper. Entry format was irregular in 1955-58 and 1958-60 (multi-year, small field) — verify per edition rather than assuming a standard bracket size.
perCompetitionNotes.UEFA: 1971-72 to 2003-04: straight knockout, some editions had a qualifying round for clubs from lower-ranked federations — excluded. 2004-05 to 2008-09: the competition added a group stage; 'main draw' for these five editions means the group stage, not the preceding knockout qualifying rounds.
perCompetitionNotes.UEL: Group stage participants throughout (2009-10 onward), excluding all qualifying and play-off rounds. From 2024-25 this becomes the 36-team league phase.
perCompetitionNotes.CONFL: 2021-22 to 2023-24: 32-team group stage, excluding qualifying and play-offs. 2024-25 onward: 36-team league phase, again excluding qualifying and play-offs.
perCompetitionNotes.ITC: The Intertoto Cup ran its own round-robin group phase directly (no separate qualifying tier to exclude) from 1995 through 2005, so 'main draw' there is simply every group entrant. 2006-2008 changed format entirely to 11 parallel single-elimination mini-tournaments with no group phase; treat every entrant to those mini-tournaments as main draw for those three years.

competitionCodes.$note: CANONICAL codes. The dataset currently uses two spellings for two competitions. Normalise on these and delete the aliases.

dataSharding.rule: Store each club-season exactly once in a stable decade shard selected by the season start year (for example 2024-25 -> clubs-2020s.json). File boundaries are storage concerns only and never encode pickability, competition, production wave or opponent status.

serieA.note: A production cycle may cover at most five Serie A seasons. Finalise and validate the whole cycle before release; the first pass is draft production, not release.

productionCycle.european: Keep each European edition atomic during research and finalisation, but merge the finished club-season rows into the relevant decade shard(s) rather than creating edition-specific production files.

rules: Never create a new production pack for routine coverage expansion; edit the relevant decade shard instead.
Do not duplicate a club-season across shards. Upgrade an existing stub to a roster in place when coverage expands.
Use season start year to choose the shard, including irregular multi-year labels such as 1955-58 -> clubs-1950s.json.
Keep source-evidence and release notes in docs/COVERAGE-AUDIT.md rather than creating one audit file per edition.
Run npm run validate after every shard edit; validation rejects rows stored in the wrong decade, duplicate club-seasons and legacy tierType.
